notes: Read SKILL.md and references/checkpointing.md, references/event-processing.md in full. TypeScript reference for Azure Event Hubs (@azure/event-hubs): producer/consumer clients, batching, partition targeting, start positions, Blob checkpoint store, load balancing, lag monitoring, error handling and graceful shutdown.

Medium because SKILL.md:18,23 and references/checkpointing.md:15 tell the agent to `npm install` official Azure SDK packages (@azure/event-hubs, @azure/identity, @azure/eventhubs-checkpointstore-blob, @azure/storage-blob; unpinned). All service calls (DefaultAzureCredential, connection strings from environment variables, createIfNotExists on a blob container) are sample code for the user's own application; the agent is not told to call the service, read secrets, or run anything else.

Connection-string auth from STORAGE_CONNECTION_STRING/EVENTHUB_CONNECTION_STRING is shown in checkpointing.md:117-147 as an alternative to Entra ID. Running samples creates a checkpoint container and advances checkpoints in the user's real storage account. event-processing.md:306-308 checkpoints past failed events (documented as an at-least-once trade-off).
